_about: Miran rebrand map — applied with `node tools/rebrand.mjs --write`. Produced from the brand brief: Miran / Miran (میران), Primary #7A4A16, Dark #46270B, Accent #D9A86C.
_mapping_notes: The reference theme uses a bright accent (#B7E600) for CTAs with dark text on top. For Miran the bright role is the kraft accent (#D9A86C) and the dark role is the brand dark (#46270B); because every lime surface in the CSS pairs with dark text, this mapping keeps contrast intact without editing rules.
Primary brown (#7A4A16) takes over the ink/link/text role (the old #2B3B66), so the logo brown is present across headings, links and labels.
Semantic colours (success green, warning amber, error red) are intentionally untouched.
Sale label (#FF047E) and final price (#EC3680) are kept from the reference design until the client approves a brand-harmonised pair.

Final price / 'قیمت فروش' label: decided #EC3680 (pink) -> #A5321A deep brick red (6.84:1 on white), so the price reads as brand-warm and stays clearly distinct from the pink sale-discount label (#FF047E) that the client chose to keep.
